auth: Requires Victus HttpOnly session cookies and X-CSRF-Token header.

response.body: Text streamed to the browser. If Victus Agent returns a JSON object, only its string `message` field is exposed and persisted.

notes: Victus Agent integration must preserve this browser-facing contract.
Tracing, status, event, and Phoenix metadata must stay behind the backend boundary and must not be rendered as assistant text.
